clos.loDetails: Learners are able to apply and explain specialized theoretical knowledge into research and application in practice.
Learners practice assessing, analyzing data, and making judgments.

Learners understand and evaluate issues related to analyzing, explain problems and situations on the basis of the theory learned; apply knowledge as well as skills of investigation, survey and analysis about topics related to language.
Learners are honest in research and proactive in the process of conducting actual surveys and data processing.
